fixes.explanation: That's it. "Go to Bethel and transgress; rebel even more at Gilgal!" Those are the LORD's words in verse 4, and I think they're startling to hear. He sets their rebellion right beside their sacrifices every morning and tithes every three days, so all that religious activity doesn't cancel out the transgressing. Verse 5 says this is what the children of Israel love to do, and then verse 6 says, "…yet you did not return to Me…"

problems.problem: The explanation still lists the sacrifices and offerings without explaining that the surprising instruction exposes Israel's rebellion alongside its religious practices.
